title: One Man Walks Into A Gang Boss's Mansion . . . Alone (highlight)
caption:
In The Man from Nowhere (2010), Jack walks alone into a gang boss's mansion, and a dozen armed men rush him. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#themanfromnowhere #koreanmovie #movierecap #thriller #spoilerroom

segments.say: A dozen armed men rush one man at once, and he takes on every *one*.
It started with a phone call. Jack tells a gang boss, bring Lily here in one hour. No more *deals*.
Mike screams threats back. He has no idea who he is *dealing* with.
Jack is holding Mike's little brother, Sam, and he is not *bluffing*.
Behind Jack, a whole building goes up in a fireball. Jack does not do *subtle*.
Next, he walks into Mike's marble mansion. Alone.
Mike asks who the hell he is.
Mike wants his brother back. Jack wants Lily *first*.
Then Mike gives the order. Kill *him*.
A dozen men rush Jack at once. Guns, knives, and bare *hands*.
When the dust settles, Jack is bleeding head to toe, and the floor is covered in *men*.
The full story is on our page.
